method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); five regulative rules (cll 8J(2), 8K(2)-(3), 8M(2), 8N(1), 9(2) with 10(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Workers Compensation Regulation 2016 (NSW), corpus document nsw_legislation:2024-07-24/sl-2016-0559 from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (collected 10 March 2025; unofficial, possibly out of date), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/sl-2016-0559.txt (sha256 9c24119b0432ea68f56b56534439fc58ab53c9de2514f088eca80d90b92ee2f5); with the words of the Workers Compensation Act 1987 ss 19, 19A, 19B and Schedule 3 cll 2, 4, 5 quoted from subjects/au/nsw/workers-compensation-act-1987/registers/source-bundle/act-1987-070.txt (corpus version 2023-10-30, same caveat)

seat: the injured worker (for work injury damages, the claimant)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run wcr-dates.l4 ; l4 run wcr-disease.l4 ; l4 run wcr-earnings.l4 ; l4 run wcr-claims.l4 ; l4 run wcr-cases-disease.l4 ; l4 run wcr-cases-earnings.l4 ; l4 run wcr-cases-claims.l4
checks.result: 241 assertions written, 241 satisfied (59 + 100 + 82), 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); one #TRACE (cl 8N(1) breach) read and as expected
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: Part 2 (cl 4 with Schedule 1; cl 5 with Schedule 2 Part 1; cl 5A; cl 5B with Schedule 2 Part 2; cl 5C(1), (3)-(5), (7); cl 5D); Part 3 (cll 6AA, 6, 7); Part 4 (cll 8, 8AA, 8AB, 8A-8C, 8D as a question, 8E, 8EA, 8G, 8H(2)-(3), 8I, 8J(2), 8K(1)-(5), (8), (11), 8L, 8M(1)-(2), 8N); Part 5 (cll 9, 10); Part 8 (cl 37, cl 38(1), cl 38A, cl 41, cll 42A, 42B); Part 9 (cll 44-49); Part 17 Division 3 Subdivision 2 (cll 94-99); cl 168; cl 175(2). Out: cl 5C(2), (6); cl 8F (judgment factors); procedural parts of cll 8J-8M; cll 35, 36, Schedule 5 (in the 1987 Act's baseline) and cl 42 (in the 1998 Act's baseline); cl 38(2), cl 38B, cll 39, 40; Parts 6, 7, 10-16, 18, Schedules 3, 4 (machinery, employer and insurer duties to others); Part 17 Divisions 1, 2, 4-6 and Schedules 6, 7 (maximum legal costs and assessment); cll 164-167, 169-174, 176; cl 177 (formula missing from the deposit). Reasons in NOTES.md.
